page.title: Security
page.intro: How you prove it is you, and how long a session stays open.

newDevice.unrecognized: This browser did not say what it is, so it counts as new. Security settings stay locked from here.
newDevice.waiting: This account gives a new device {grace, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before it can change security settings. This one has {left, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left.

newDevice.title: This device is still new here
newDevice.hint: Use a device you have signed in from before, or wait it out. Signing out from here still works.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing it signs out every other session.

authenticator.title: Authenticator app
authenticator.description: A time-based code from your phone, asked for after your password.

pin.title: Quick unlock PIN
pin.description: Reopens a locked dashboard, and confirms a sign-in you allow from here.

questions.title: Security questions
questions.description: Used to set a new password when you have forgotten the current one.

grace.title: New devices
grace.description: Make a browser you have not signed in from before wait before it can change anything on this page. It buys you time to notice if someone else signs in with your password.
grace.label: Wait before a new device can change security
grace.hint: A waiting device can still read this page and sign itself out. Devices you already use are not affected, and neither is the one you opened this account from.

limits.title: Session limits
limits.description: When to lock the dashboard, and when to end the session outright.
limits.hint: Unlocking asks for your PIN, or your password when no PIN is set.

errors.needsProof: Confirm it is you again before changing this.
errors.noLongerConnected: That account is no longer connected.
errors.pickOfferedWait: Pick one of the offered waits.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.tooManyCodes: Too many codes asked for. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.notVerified: We could not verify that. Check your answers or code and try again.
errors.approvalNeedsPin: Turn off approving sign-ins from an open session first - it asks for this PIN.
errors.authenticatorFirst: Turn the authenticator app off first - a sign-in asks for one of the two, not both.
errors.pinFirst: Set a quick unlock PIN first - approving a sign-in asks for it.
errors.connectWhatsAppFirst: Connect one of your WhatsApp channels first - the code is sent through it.
errors.messageNotSent: The message could not be sent.
errors.passkeyGone: That passkey is no longer on your account.
errors.useSignOut: Use Sign out to end this session.
errors.sessionGone: That session is no longer signed in.
errors.deviceForgotten: That device is no longer remembered.

phone.confirmationMessage: {code} is your Polaris confirmation code. It expires in {minutes} minutes.

backupCodes.title: Backup codes
backupCodes.offDescription: Single-use codes that get you in without the authenticator. They come with it.
backupCodes.description: Single-use codes that stand in for the authenticator when you cannot reach it.
backupCodes.unreadable: The stored set could not be read. Generating a new one replaces it.
backupCodes.allUsed: Every code has been used. Without the authenticator there is no way back in.
backupCodes.runningLow: Running low. Generate a new set before you need one.
backupCodes.notGenerated: The codes could not be generated.
backupCodes.saveNow: Save these now. This is the only time they are shown.
backupCodes.oldStopWorking: Your current codes stop working straight away, including any you have printed.
backupCodes.panelLabel: Each code works once. Keep them somewhere you can reach without your phone.
backupCodes.panelDefault: Backup codes - each works once, store them somewhere safe. They are not shown again.

connected.title: Connected accounts
connected.description: Choose which of the accounts you have connected can sign you in.
connected.empty: You have not connected any. Connect one under Connected accounts to use it here.
connected.stepUp: Changing which accounts can sign you in decides how this account is reached. You will not be asked again for a couple of minutes.
connected.notAllowed: {provider} is not allowed as a way in on this Polaris

challenge.title: Ask for my second step too
challenge.description: Signing in this way answers the other service first, so Polaris does not ask again unless you want it to.
challenge.label: Ask for my second step after a connected account signs me in
challenge.enforced: This Polaris asks for it on every account.

lockdown.title: Lock this account down
lockdown.description: For when you think somebody else is in your account and you need everything to stop while you work out what happened.
lockdown.lockedDescription: It stays this way until you lift it. An administrator has been told and is looking at it.

effects.protection: Nothing about how your account is protected can be changed - not the password, not the second step, not a passkey, not a connected account.
effects.signIn: No new sign-in works, however correct the password is.
effects.devices: The devices already signed in keep working, so you do not lock yourself out of lifting it.
effects.administrator: An administrator is told, and looks at the account.

leaving.title: Switching off, and leaving
leaving.description: Both sign out every device. Signing in again is all it takes to undo either - there is nothing else to do and nobody to ask.

lockdown.title: Lock this account down?
lockdown.description: Nothing about how it is protected can be changed and no new sign-in works. The devices already signed in keep working, so you can lift it again.

lift.title: Lift the lockdown?
lift.description: Sign-ins and security settings work again. The administrator looking at your account is not affected either way.

disabled.title: Switch this account off?
disabled.description: It disappears for everybody else and every device is signed out. Sign in whenever you like and it comes straight back.

deleting.title: Delete this account?
deleting.description: Nothing is removed for {days} days, and signing in before then calls it off. After that it is gone and cannot be brought back.

lockdown.notePlaceholder: Optional. Whoever looks at this reads it.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with your device instead of a password. Each passkey works on the address it was added from, so add one per address you use.
passkeys.nameTaken: You already have a passkey with this name.
passkeys.notCompleted: That did not complete. Try again.
passkeys.removeDescription: That device can no longer sign in with this passkey.
passkeys.empty: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in with this device.
passkeys.onIpAddress: You are on an IP address. A passkey needs a hostname, so open Polaris on a domain or on its local name to add one.
passkeys.plainHttp: This address is served over plain HTTP, and browsers only create passkeys over HTTPS. Open Polaris on {host} over HTTPS to add one.
passkeys.noneHere: None of these work on {host}. Add one to sign in here with your device.
passkeys.confirmDescription: Adding a passkey adds a way into your account, so it asks for your password first. Your device will prompt you next.

emailLink.title: Sign in with an emailed link
emailLink.description: A link sent to your address opens the account without your password. It works once, expires in 10 minutes, and your second step is still asked for.
emailLink.label: Sign in with a link emailed to me
emailLink.cannotSend: This Polaris cannot send email yet, so there is nowhere to send the link.

password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
password.changed: Password changed. Every other session was signed out.
password.recoverDescription: Prove it is you without your current password, then choose a new one.
password.noWayToVerify: Set security questions or an authenticator first - without one of them there is no way to verify you here.
password.set: Password set. Every other session was signed out.

pin.description: 4 to 6 digits, used only to reopen a locked dashboard.
pin.removeDescription: A locked dashboard will then ask for your password.

questions.duplicate: Use a different question for each answer.
questions.description: All {count} must be answered correctly to set a new password without the old one.
questions.removeDescription: Without them, a forgotten password can only be recovered with an authenticator code.

suggestions.pet: What was the name of your first pet?
suggestions.city: What city were you born in?
suggestions.car: What was the make of your first car?
suggestions.sibling: What is your oldest sibling's middle name?
suggestions.school: What was the name of your first school?
suggestions.street: What street did you live on at age ten?

known.lockedDown: Your account is locked down. Lift it under Security before changing anything else.
known.passkeyUnnamed: Name this passkey before adding it.
known.passkeyNameTaken: One of your passkeys is already called that.
known.noCodesIssued: No codes were issued. Try again.
known.codeExpired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
known.tooManyWrongTries: Too many wrong tries. Ask for a new code.
known.notAWayToConfirm: That is not a way this account can confirm.
known.signInNotWaiting: That sign-in is no longer waiting.
known.reportFailed: That account could not be reported.
known.sameAsVault: That is your vault's master password. If they are the same, whoever learns one has the vault as well.
known.successorAmbiguous: More than one account has that name - use their username or email address
known.successorNoMatch: No account matches that username, name or email address
known.successorSelf: Name somebody else - you cannot succeed yourself
known.noConfirmedAddress: No confirmed address on your account.
known.noEmailChannel: Polaris has no email channel to send from.
known.confirmPhoneFirst: Confirm a phone number on your profile first.
known.noWhatsAppChannel: None of your WhatsApp channels is connected.
known.noAuthenticator: No authenticator is set up on this account.
known.answerOrCode: Answer your security questions or use an authenticator code
known.methodOffDefault: Turn the method on before making it the default
known.phoneFormat: Use the international form, for example +34600111222
known.passwordMinLength: New password must be at least {count} characters.
